plugins.name: bad-research
plugins.description: Deep, fully-cited research that works in rounds: a broad pass maps the question, then deeper passes chase what it found, with parallel research-reader agents exchanging through one written map, a fresh-context critic pass, and every claim bound to a source. The Python `bad` engine self-bootstraps on first use (needs Python 3.11-3.13 and uv or pipx).
